topic: Java traces stop after adding OpenTelemetry agent
environment: Datadog Java tracer plus OpenTelemetry Java agent on the same JVM
symptom_pattern: Traces for a Java service stop after the team adds the OpenTelemetry Java agent to forward application logs elsewhere; removing it restores traces but breaks their log shipping.
root_cause: Two -javaagent instrumentation agents on one JVM is unsupported; they conflict on bytecode instrumentation and silently suppress traces. The log path doesn't need a javaagent.
resolution_path: Confirm the JVM flags show two -javaagent entries
Explain the conflict and point to compatibility docs
Move log forwarding to an appender or node-level forwarder; keep one tracing agent
info_needed: what the OTel agent is used for

qa_pairs.tse_question: Can you share the JVM command line?
What do you use the OTel agent for besides tracing?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: Only to ship app logs to our cloud provider's logging service.

customer_style.tone: pragmatic architect, wants both tools to work
